shots.content: Inside a seminar room, a rectangular worktable stands between a pinboard and the entrance, with windows along one side. A woman in an emerald blouse sits at the pinboard-side window seat and asks a question, a man in a navy cardigan sits at the entrance-side window seat, a woman in a mustard turtleneck sits at the pinboard-side aisle seat, and a man in a charcoal blazer sits at the entrance-side aisle seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the entrance end, looking lengthwise along the worktable toward the pinboard, with both window-side seats and both aisle-side seats in frame.

shots.content: The woman in an emerald blouse at the pinboard-side window seat swaps seats with the man in a navy cardigan at the entrance-side window seat, and she asks while he answers.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: The woman in a mustard turtleneck asks, and the man in a charcoal blazer replies.
shots.viewpoint: Top-down wide shot from directly above the worktable, centered on the tabletop, with both window-side seats and both aisle-side seats in frame.
